tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Page ground. The black the slick sits on. Default theme is dark; Daylight is for print and documents.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, table bodies. One step up from void.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hover states, selected rows, the quiet tile in a breakdown.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Rules, borders, grid lines, the cuts between tiles in a breakdown. Never thicker than 1px.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headlines. 4.5:1 or better on void, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, source lines, secondary labels. Still 4.5:1 on void and surface.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Primary. Links, the main action, the largest tile in a breakdown. The slick's dominant hue.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Sheen. The second tile color, positive deltas, 'released' or 'cleared' states. Never means 'good' on its own; pair with a label.

tokens.name: magenta
tokens.usage: Sheen. Third tile color, highlighted figures, the live tick on the Cage Clock. Use at most once per screen as emphasis.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Sheen, rare. Dollar figures and cost lines only. If gold appears, it is money.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Deaths in custody and error states. Semantic only; never decorative, never in the slick.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px outline with 2px offset.

tokens.name: on-violet
tokens.usage: Text on a violet fill.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text on a green fill.

tokens.name: on-magenta
tokens.usage: Text on a magenta fill.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The name, campaign headlines, one per page.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Big Prison has a name now.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: What the county pays per day

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Texas holds about 70,000 people in county jails on any given night. Most have not been convicted of anything.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Source: TCJS Abbreviated Population Report, Sept. 2026
styles.usage: Captions and the source line under every figure.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The big number in a Figure. Always tabular; always with a source line.

styles.name: figure-sm
styles.usage: Secondary figures, legislator cage counts in a list.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Table cells, citations, timestamps, the clock's tick.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The cut between tiles in a breakdown. Icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and labels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a figure and its source line.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; page gutter minimum.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; between stacked cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections of a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section margins on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Above and below a display headline.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Page top on posters and covers.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Tiles in a breakdown, tables, anything that is a piece of something larger.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills only.
